evals.prompt: I'm running an in-house engineering doctrine on a project whose production foundation is cloud-hosted (AWS). I've never cut a production release for this project before — the cloud account exists and the shared master VPC is already in place, but nothing project-specific has been provisioned in the cloud yet. Before I can bring up the stage and prod environments, what project-wide (shared-across-environments) infrastructure has to be stood up first? Give me the complete set of resources, note any choices I get to make about the inbound traffic / reverse-proxy layer, and call out anything about the ordering or bootstrapping that isn't obvious. Keep it focused.
evals.expected_output: The full elastic production-side project-tier resource set: the OpenTofu state backend (S3 bucket + DynamoDB lock table), a Route53 hosted zone for the project, two ACM wildcard certs (stage + prod), the reverse proxy (a choice of ALB vs. a single EC2-traefik instance), one ECR repository per core service, and the ECS task-execution IAM role. Plus the two non-obvious ordering facts: the state backend must be created OUT-of-band (not by tofu, since tofu can't create its own backend), and the apply pauses mid-way for manual NS delegation of the new zone before ACM certs can validate.
expectations: DELTA DRIVER (doctrine-specific, not inferable): names essentially the complete project-tier set for elastic production — OpenTofu state backend (S3 + DynamoDB), Route53 hosted zone, two ACM certs, the reverse proxy, per-core-service ECR repositories, AND the ECS task-execution IAM role — rather than a generic/partial cloud-stack list

DELTA DRIVER (doctrine-specific, not inferable): states the reverse proxy is a choice between exactly two mutually-exclusive options — the default ALB or a single EC2 instance running traefik — selected via `reverse_proxy:` in infra.yml, and that the EC2-traefik path does NOT use ACM (it self-issues via Let's Encrypt)

DELTA DRIVER (doctrine-specific, not inferable): identifies the state backend (S3 bucket + DynamoDB lock table) as a bootstrap precondition that must be created directly via the AWS API / out-of-band rather than by tofu apply, because tofu cannot create the very backend it needs to track state

DELTA DRIVER (doctrine-specific, not inferable): calls out the two-phase apply — the first run creates only the Route53 zone and then pauses for the operator to NS-delegate the zone from the parent registrar, because ACM cert (DNS-01) validation cannot succeed until delegation propagates; the second run completes the remaining resources

CONFIRMATORY (inferable, expect ~zero with/without-skill delta): notes that these resources are shared across all environments (provisioned once, not per-env) and must exist before stage/prod env stacks come up
CONFIRMATORY (inferable, expect ~zero with/without-skill delta): mentions that the ACM certs cover wildcard domains for stage and prod and are validated via DNS against the Route53 zone
